 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Split the grid into regions separated by complete lines of the divider color.
    divider = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hcuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == divider for v in row)]
    vcuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    def ranges(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for c in cuts + [n]:
            if start < c: out.append((start,c))
            start=c+1
        return out
    rs, cs = ranges(h,hcuts), ranges(w,vcuts)
    colors = [v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != divider]
    marker = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    bg = min(colors, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    fg = next((v for v in colors if v not in (marker,bg)), 1)
    return [[fg if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) >= 2 else bg
             for c0,c1 in cs] for r0,r1 in rs]

def transform(grid):
    # Split the grid into regions separated by complete rows/columns of one color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    divider = next(v for v in candidates if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)
                   or any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    hcuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == divider for v in row)]
    vcuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    def ranges(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for c in cuts + [n]:
            if start < c: out.append((start,c))
            start=c+1
        return out
    rs, cs = ranges(h,hcuts), ranges(w,vcuts)
    colors = [v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != divider]
    marker = min(colors, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    fg = 1
    return [[fg if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) >= 2 else bg
             for c0,c1 in cs] for r0,r1 in rs]
